title: Cooper Companies Inc - proposed acquisition of Ocular Sciences Inc.

body_sections.Summary: Hydron Pty Ltd proposed merger with Ocular Sciences Australia, arising from the global merger between The Cooper Companies Inc and Ocular Sciences Inc.
body_sections.Market definition: Distribution of contact lenses in Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: In December 2004, the ACCC decided not to oppose the merger due to competition from three other international suppliers, namely Johnson & Johnson, CIBA Vision and Bausch & Lomb. The majority of all product supplied to the Australian market is imported.  The ACCC concluded that the merger would not substantially lessen competition.
